AD MANAGER

Sell the digital edition like the print one.

Connect Google Ad Manager. The flat plan sends issue, folio and page with every ad request, direct-sold orders show their pace, and reports tell you which positions earn the most.

0{{ k.l }}
01 · AD UNITS

Every placement mapped to inventory.

Cover sponsorship, right rail, interstitial: each digital placement links to one Google ad unit. Auto-link by name or one at a time. The forecast shows booked against available so sales never oversells.

02 · ORDERS & LINE ITEMS

See which campaigns are behind, before the advertiser does.

Delivery bars show impressions against the goal. Amber means behind pace. Missing creative jumps straight to upload and attaches the file to the line item.

03 · TARGETING

The plan travels with every ad request.

Issue, folio and page go out as key-values automatically. An advertiser key keeps competitors off facing pages, and yield rules set price floors for unsold space.

WHY FLIPANDSHARE

Other tools make flipbooks. We run the issue.

FlipAndShare comes from 22 years of building software for magazine publishers. The flipbook is the part readers see. Behind it sit the flat plan, the booked ads, the advertiser materials, the sign-offs and the report you send each advertiser after the issue goes out.

OUR COMPANY

Two decades of building software for people who publish.

FlipAndShare is made by Mirabel Technologies, the team behind Magazine Manager. We started with ad sales and production for print magazines. FlipAndShare brings the same workflow to the digital edition.

OUR MISSION

Help independent publishers earn more from every issue they already make.

Most of our customers are small teams: a publisher, an editor, a couple of sales reps and a designer. They don't need another tool to learn. They need the digital edition to fit the way they already sell and produce the magazine, and to show advertisers what their money bought.

One login for everyone, managed where you already manage people.

SAML and OIDC with Okta, Microsoft Entra, Google Workspace or any provider. SCIM keeps users, groups and roles in sync, so a new hire has the right access on day one and a leaver has none the same hour.
